arxiv-2505-21888.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Guangming Liu, Hsing-Ta Chen. We further dissect the current flux into its bare excitonic contribution and transport via the cavity photon.

uslaw-usc-t46-s30906.title: 46 U.S.C. § 30906 — Venue
uslaw-usc-t46-s30906.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s30906.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Chapter 309 (Suits In Admiralty Against The United States). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In General.— A civil action under this chapter shall be brought in the district court of the United States for the district in which— (1) any plaintiff resides or has its principal place of business; or (2) the vessel or cargo.
